questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring the design process. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to the design process, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with the design process. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with the design process. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate thorough research into the brief, audience and context; generate multiple ideas before selecting; show systematic development and refinement; annotate every decision with clear rationale; reference graphic designers and existing designs. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
